records.name: Philomusica Chorale
records.summary: An auditioned volunteer chorus in Chestnut Hill that rehearses on Monday evenings from September to May and performs concerts each season.
records.what_you_do: Sing in one of the four voice sections, learn the season's music, and perform at the season's concerts. Newcomers can sit in on a few rehearsals before deciding to audition.

schedule.text: Mondays 7 to 9:30 pm, September through May, in Widener Hall at the Presbyterian Church of Chestnut Hill. Mostly in person, with occasional Zoom sessions.

locations.label: Widener Hall, Presbyterian Church of Chestnut Hill

cost.text: Suggested annual contribution of $300 to $600 per singer for the 2026 to 2027 season. The chorale says no successful auditioner is turned away for money reasons.

first_step.how: Request an audition time through the contact form on philomusicachorale.org, or email philomusicaoffice@gmail.com. You can also sit in on a few rehearsals first.
first_step.basis: The site says all ages, genders and singing abilities are welcome, the audition is low stress, and visitors can sit in on a few rehearsals before deciding.

records.notes: Listed in the Cultural Alliance directory as Philomusica Chorale of Delaware Valley. Rehearsal times come from the group's own site (7 to 9:30 pm); the singers.com listing says 7:30 pm. The dated items on the site are 2027 concerts and the 2026 to 2027 season fee. Audition times are arranged on request, and the site publishes an email and a contact form but no phone number.

records.name: Singing City
records.summary: An auditioned volunteer choir in Philadelphia that rehearses on Tuesday nights at Friends Center from September through May.
records.what_you_do: Sing in weekly Tuesday rehearsals, with occasional all-day Saturday sessions before major performances. Members need to live within about 50 miles of the city.

schedule.text: Tuesdays 7:20 to 9:50 pm, September through May, at Friends Center on Cherry Street. Occasional all-day Saturday rehearsals before major performances.

cost.text: The audition page lists no membership fee. It lists parking at Friends Center at $24 with a validation sticker, or $12 for evening parking two blocks away.

first_step.how: Submit the Audition Request Form on singingcity.org. Auditions are held every August and by appointment during the season, and the page says they are by invitation only.
first_step.basis: You need an audition request and approval before joining, so it is not open to walk-ins, though the request form is a clear first step.

records.notes: Listed in the Cultural Alliance directory. The audition page names the 2026 to 2027 season and says the choir is taking tenor and bass auditions, with no month given, so last_sign_of_life is left out. A search summary said auditions had closed; the choir's own page was used instead. A youth section is linked from the site but was not read, so it is not described here.

records.name: The Philadelphia Chorus
records.summary: A community chorus founded in 1951 that holds auditions by appointment and is marking its 75th anniversary with a concert on December 5, 2026.
records.what_you_do: Audition by appointment, then sing with the chorus in rehearsals and concerts. Singers must be 18 or older.

schedule.text: Rehearsals on Mondays in University City, per a third-party directory listing (the chorus's own site gives no rehearsal times). 75th anniversary concert: Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 4 pm at the Philadelphia Episcopal Cathedral.

cost.text: No dues or fees are stated on the chorus's own site.

first_step.how: Call 215-995-3118 or email thephiladelphiachorus@gmail.com to book an audition by appointment. The audition has scales and warm-ups, one piece of the singer's choice, and sight-reading.
first_step.basis: Joining takes an audition by appointment, though the audition steps and contact details are published.

records.notes: Listed in the Cultural Alliance directory. The rehearsal day and place come only from the singers.com listing, which has no date; the chorus's own site gives no rehearsal times, so confirm before going. Voice parts are not specified on the site. The phone number is on both the auditions page and the third-party listing.

records.name: Philadelphia Voices of Pride
records.summary: An LGBTQ and ally mixed voice chorus in Philadelphia that holds two audition windows a year and also welcomes non-singing members.
records.what_you_do: Audition to sing with the chorus, or join as a non-singing member. Rehearsals are on Tuesday nights.

schedule.text: Rehearsals on Tuesday nights at Resurrection Philadelphia, 123 S 17th St. Auditions are held in summer (August) and winter (January). The next audition is listed as Tuesday, August 11, starting at 6 pm; the page does not give a year.

cost.text: No dues or fees are stated on the join page or the home page.

first_step.how: Email membership@pvop.org to sign up for an audition, or to join as a non-singing member. Singers need a pleasant voice and a love of music. Classical training is not required, and prepared music is optional.
first_step.basis: There is a clear, low-bar way in by email, no training is required, and non-singers can join too. Singing members still need the audition.

records.notes: Listed in the Cultural Alliance directory. The singers.com listing says rehearsals are at William Way Community Center; the group's own join page says Resurrection Philadelphia, which is used here. The 1315 Spruce Street address is the organization's listed address and is not identified as a rehearsal site. The Upcoming Events page is linked but was not read, so no dated events are recorded.

records.name: PhillyCAM
records.summary: Philadelphia's public access media nonprofit, where residents learn video production and submit their own programs for the public access channel.
records.what_you_do: Attend the required orientation, then take a workshop such as field production, production planning, or Premiere Pro editing. Equipment checkout also requires the orientation.

schedule.text: Workshops run as short courses, such as a 4 week production planning workshop and a 6 week Premiere Pro class. The FAQ page gives no dates or times.

cost.text: Classes are listed at prices such as $75 for Basic Field Production. The FAQ page does not show a membership fee.

first_step.how: Attend the orientation, which is required before workshops, equipment checkout and facility use, and join as a member. Questions go to education@phillycam.org or 267.639.5481.
first_step.basis: Membership and an orientation come before any workshop, and the membership fee is not on the FAQ, so the way in is clear but needs sign-up first.

records.notes: Listed in the Cultural Alliance directory. The FAQ does not say whether non-members can take the classes, so only the membership requirement is recorded. Volunteer and internship roles appear only as member services, with no sign-up steps. The only dates seen are year labels (a 2025 internships page, 2026 schedule pages), so status is probably_active rather than active.

records.name: Scribe Video Center
records.summary: A Philadelphia media arts center that teaches video and digital media workshops, rents production equipment, and runs community video projects.
records.what_you_do: Take a video workshop, rent production gear once you have shown you can use it, or join the volunteer list for screenings and events.

schedule.text: Office open Monday to Friday, 10 am to 6 pm, plus some weeknight and Saturday workshops. The FAQ suggests calling ahead.

cost.text: Workshop, class and membership prices are not on the FAQ page. Members get a discount on equipment rental.

first_step.how: Email inquiry@scribe.org or call 215.222.4201 to ask about the next workshop, membership, or the volunteer list. Membership details are on the site's join page.
first_step.basis: The FAQ says the center is open to the public and lists workshops, but it does not describe beginner levels or costs, so ask first.

records.notes: Listed in the Cultural Alliance directory. The 2026 Street Movies call for works is the only 2026 item seen on the jobs page, and it gives no deadline. Other items there are undated, except a 2015 listing date. A search summary mentioned a community filmmakers deadline in late 2026; it was not on any page read, so it is not written here. Membership and workshop prices were not on the pages read.

records.name: Philadelphia Folklore Project
records.summary: Philadelphia's folk and traditional arts organization. It runs free hands-on arts workshops at public library branches and works with local artists on community projects.
records.what_you_do: Join a free library workshop on a traditional craft or arts topic, volunteer or intern in roles arranged to fit you, or join the mailing list.

schedule.text: Free arts workshops at Free Library of Philadelphia branches across the city. Dates and times are on the library's calendar (search for 'folklore'), not on the group's site. Volunteer and internship roles have no set hours.

cost.text: The library workshops are free, according to the group's September 2024 news item.

first_step.how: Check the Free Library calendar for 'folklore' workshops, or call +1 215.726.1106 to ask about volunteering or an internship. Volunteer applications are accepted on a rolling basis, with no deadlines.
first_step.basis: The library workshops are free and open to the public, and volunteer roles are open all year on a rolling basis, though the group's page does not list a sign-up form.

records.notes: Listed in the Cultural Alliance directory. Community Kitchens is a food sales fundraiser (boxed dinners split with local artists and businesses), not a way to join. Free Library workshop sign-up runs through the library calendar. The 2024 copyright footer was not used as evidence. The groups named on this site without links are in leads_only.

notes: Searches: 3 of 3, cap reached. Fetches: 41 of 60. Records cover only the 7 groups whose own sites could be read. The Greater Philadelphia Cultural Alliance directory (9 pages, about 360 names) has no external website links, and its profile pages return 403, so most member groups could not be checked; they are in leads_only for future research. Theatre Philadelphia's member list is blocked, so theatre companies are not covered. Own sites for the choirs came through links on third-party singers.com listings and one search. Gamelan Gita Santi is held as a lead because its listing does not confirm current classes or join rules. Commonwealth Youthchoirs has no verified site. Anna Crusis Feminist Choir has no verified site. The target of 25 to 50 records was not reached; the limits were the directory's lack of website links, blocked profiles, and the 3-search cap. Status: where a page shows only a season or year label (Singing City, Philomusica, Scribe, PhillyCAM), last_sign_of_life is left out; probably_active is used where the evidence is a year label or no dated item. Newcomer ratings and audience fields follow each group's own published wording.
